pilot.title: Paid plans aren’t available during the free pilot.
pilot.body: Nothing was charged and no invoice was made. Your current plan stays as it is, and free plans, your events, invitations, guest lists and free tickets keep working.

current.title: Your plan
current.none: Your organization hasn’t chosen a plan. You can choose one below.
current.cancel: Cancel at the end of the period

standing.ending: Ends on {{date}}. You keep it until then, and can still keep it.
standing.lapsed: The period ended on {{date}}. Nothing renews by itself: choose a plan to start again.
standing.pastDue: A payment is overdue. The period runs until {{date}}.
standing.ended: This plan has ended. Choose a plan to start again.

cancel.title: Cancel at the end of the period?
cancel.body: You keep the plan until {{date}}, and can change your mind until then.
cancel.confirm: Cancel at the end of the period

plans.title: Plans
plans.notEnforced: The events, guests and languages listed are what each plan is meant to include: Aveline doesn’t hold you to them yet. How long an invitation stays up does apply.
plans.none: No plans are on offer just now.

limits.lifetime_one: The invitation stays up {{count}} day after the event
limits.lifetime_other: The invitation stays up {{count}} days after the event
limits.lifetimeAny: The invitation stays up with no end date

paid.title: Choose {{name}}?
paid.body: {{price}}. You’ll go to the bank’s page to pay. Your plan starts once the payment is confirmed. An invoice still waiting for another plan is withdrawn.

paidChange.title: Change to {{name}}?
paidChange.body: {{price}}. You’ll go to the bank’s page to pay. Your plan stays as it is until it’s paid, and then the new plan starts at once. An invoice still waiting for another plan is withdrawn.

free.title: Choose {{name}}?
free.body: It’s free and starts now. An invoice still waiting to be paid is withdrawn.

freeOverPaid.title: Change to {{name}}?
freeOverPaid.body: It’s free and starts now. The rest of the period you paid for ends at once, with no refund. An invoice still waiting to be paid is withdrawn.
freeOverPaid.confirm: End my paid period and change

pay.title: Pay invoice {{name}}?
pay.body: {{price}}. You’ll go to the bank’s page to pay. Nothing changes until it’s paid.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.zone: Dates are in Yerevan time. Open an invoice to see what it’s for.
invoices.notTax: This isn’t a tax document: no tax is worked out yet.

refused.pilot: Paid plans aren’t available during the free pilot.
refused.forbidden: Only your organization’s owner can see and change its plan and invoices.
refused.noOrganization: Plans and invoices belong to an organization, and your account isn’t in one.
refused.chooseOrganization: Choose which organization this tab works in, then try again.
refused.planGone: This plan is no longer on offer. Nothing has changed.
refused.noBank: Paying by card isn’t set up here yet. Nothing has changed.
refused.noSubscription: Your organization has no plan to change. Reload the page.
refused.periodEnded: This period has already ended. Choose a plan to start again.
refused.noInvoice: We couldn’t find this invoice in your organization.
refused.noPayment: This invoice has no payment to check yet.
refused.disagreement: The bank and our record of this payment disagree.
refused.rateLimited: Too many requests just now. Wait a minute, then try again.
refused.noAnswer: We didn’t get an answer. Check your connection and try again.
refused.refunding: This payment is already being refunded. You don’t need to do anything.

return.title: Back from the bank
return.paid: Your payment is confirmed, and your plan is active.
return.awaitingBank: The bank hasn’t confirmed this payment yet. Your plan hasn’t changed so far. Please wait a few minutes before paying again.
return.notPaid: This payment didn’t go through, and no money moved. Your plan is as it was.
return.replaced: This invoice was replaced by a newer choice of plan, and its payment didn’t go through: nothing was charged for it.
return.closed: This invoice can’t be paid any more. Your plan is as it was.
return.dontPayAgain: Please don’t pay again. Keep the reference above: it lets us find this payment.
return.replacedOpen: This invoice was replaced by a newer choice of plan. If you paid it at the bank, that money comes back to you by itself. You don’t need to do anything.
return.refunded: This invoice was withdrawn, and what was paid for it goes back to you.

pricing.title: Prices
pricing.lead: What each Aveline plan costs and what it includes.
